主要内容: Credicorp Ltd. (Credicorp) has approved its Annual and Sustainability Report for the financial year ended December 31, 2021, along with its annexes, to be presented at its Annual General Meeting (AGM) on March 29, 2022. The report includes the Sustainability Strategy of Credicorp and the consolidated financial statements for the same period, which will be presented at the AGM. The external auditors, Gaveglio Aparicio y Asociados, representatives of PricewaterhouseCoopers in Peru, have been recommended for reappointment as the external auditors for the financial year 2022. The company has distributed the supporting documents for the AGM proposal between March 1 and March 4, 2022.
